annotations.text:
Dense trading terminal — dark-first, IBM Plex Sans/Mono, tabular figures everywhere.
Deliberately NOT the old navy-and-gold SaaS look: no white cards, no gold, no Inter.

Same palette, type and components as the desktop terminal — at thumb density.
44px targets, tables become cards. This is B6's density token, shown rather than argued.
Cap headroom leads every member screen. It is the plan's hardest limit and was buried in the old build — now it is the first number, segmented by which stream is consuming it.
